decisions.reason: 0.44 hotfix cold preparation/producer ordering adopted; menu-only immutable chain model/adaptive policies, disabled F9 twin prewarm/head, fixed unused UAV binding. Existing three explicit deferrals remain.
decisions.validation: docs/lmxxf-044-hotfix-consumer-review.md#validation; MSVC Runtime/host, ABI23, CPU model/config12, GPU models/history/replay, inline4, six cold-producer cases, split/3-slot first-pass with debug and focused sync8/module contract pass. decisions.next_step: Cold-start Crimson Desert with a matching ABI6 complete package, NrInline and LmxxfAllowEnhancedBarriers; compare split and 1-5 slots in the same scene/session, checking pixels, displayed pacing, queries/layouts and long-run VRAM/retained recordings. Exercise varying external exposure/motion/depth, more model/pass/numeric/extent combinations and other adapters/drivers. Preserve person-partition semantic-mask and first-pass acceptance deferrals. Rebuild full Mochizuki source/shader package before release; authoritative release regression remains GitHub Actions. Trace sustained Mochizuki FLOAT graphics/compute segments with concurrent game waits; reproduce same-format full-compute/forced-segment differences. Validate any fix without losing HDR/FLOAT precision, temporal behavior or first-pass exports; complete native/ACO forward/reverse and paced performance matrices before claiming its inline performance accepted. GPU-armed capture-proof research is stopped by user decision; resume only when requested, within the documented 90-minute/2-hour limit, with <=3% throughput gap and proven failure-path input/history safety. Preserve all other existing deferrals. Small: adapt LowFrequency2/3 processing stride/model parameters/recording resources, then WARP analytical and GPU cold/switch/replay/continuous-frame acceptance before allowing it; current fallback is Original. Run gfx1200 model/history and controlled product ABBA/game/long-run acceptance.
